citations.quote: The cash flow statement tracks operating and investment activities with cash accounting
The dividend discount model is a straight application of the bond valuation model in the last chapter to valuing equity
The relationship among the three parts of the balance sheet (assets, liabilities, and owners’ equity) may be shown in equation form as follows: Assets = Liabilities + Owners’ equity

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Explains why net income (accrual measure) and operating cash flow (cash measure) disagree by construction; frames accrual accounting as the system that records revenues when earned and expenses when incurred regardless of cash timing; gives the analyst guidance on which measure to weight under which question.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Cash vs Accrual Accounting
